name: Telegrad
description: The East, The Evergreens, The Valley of a Thousand Homesteads. Fed by the Halard Reservoir and the Central Lake, the Federation of Telegrad has grown beyond its valley to become a large and expansive place, considered by many to be an idyllic paradise. No merchant schemes, no draft, no existential threat that looms in the outskirts.

name: Geladyne
description: Geladyne is a militaristic monarchy that carries itself with due selfishness on the world stage.

name: Meiaquar
description: Meiaquar is an economic powerhouse, a nation built upon commerce through its ports, craftsmen, and exports. The northernmost influence of Korvara, where crime is potentially around every corner.

name: Yokoshura
description: Yokoshura is an eastern-styled desert nation in the southwestern reaches of Korvara. Its golden Myr Tree bears jewel-like seeds that can reverse the desertification of its lands, for a price in blood the Yokoshurans willingly pay.

name: Wanderer's Vale
description: The Wanderer's Vale acts as a small mini-territory/nation that values its independence and neutrality greatly. It hosts the biggest mega-tavern/inn with a heavily enchanted arena inside for fights that can be safely spectated. While it makes good coin through the heavy travel traffic it gets, it also acts as a trade hub for additional coin and even an adventuring hub with its quest system.
